tools.name: list_models
tools.description: See which AI video or image models can make a video ad, animate a photo, produce a product clip or generate an image, with the credit cost of one generation. No account needed. The list is live; `count` is the number of models currently offered.

tools.name: estimate_credit_cost
tools.description: Price a video or image before making it. Returns the exact credit cost and a quote_id that generate_video and generate_image require. No account needed. Pass the duration and resolution you intend to use; some video models bill per second.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search AI Content Drop's published guides and model comparisons about AI video generation, prompting, and ad creative.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one published article as markdown, by slug.

tools.name: list_ad_formats
tools.description: See the ad formats the studio can produce — UGC, talking head, unboxing, tutorial, TV spot, product hero, hyper-motion, try-on and more — with a one-line description, the default aspect and the allowed shot count and duration. No account needed. Pick one before writing a brief.

tools.name: list_ugc_avatars
tools.description: See the catalogue creators available for a UGC video — name, style and a portrait URL — and the fields generate_ugc_video accepts. No account needed. A person's own photo can be used instead, with their consent.

tools.name: estimate_ad_cost
tools.description: Price a studio job before making it: a finished ad from a brief or storyboard (kind "ad"), a UGC creator video (kind "ugc"), a generated avatar (kind "avatar") or a competitor-ad decode (kind "decode"). Returns the credit lines, the total and a quote_id that generate_ad, generate_ugc_video, generate

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Make an AI video: a product ad, a vertical clip for social, a cinematic shot, or animate a photo into video (image-to-video). Requires a quote_id from estimate_credit_cost so the price is agreed first; then returns a job id to poll with get_generation. Credits are charged only when the video succeed

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Make an AI image: a product still, a thumbnail, a poster, concept art, or a reference frame to animate later. Requires a quote_id from estimate_credit_cost so the price is agreed first; then returns a job id to poll with get_generation (kind "image"). Credits are charged only when the image succeeds

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check whether a video or image is finished and get its URL. Poll this after generate_video or generate_image; pass kind "image" for an image job. Reports status, the finished file URL, and the credits charged. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API

tools.name: list_generations

SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Check the signed-in account's remaining credits and current plan name before generating, and get the informational page about plans and entitlement. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_ugc_avatars, get_generation, list_generations, get_ad_job · Private data: generate_video, generate_image, get_generation, list_generations, get_account, write_ad_storyboard, generate_ad, get_ad_job, generate_ugc_video, generate_avatar, import_asset, list_brand_profiles, import_brand_profile, list_canvases, create_canvas, get_canvas, rename_canvas, get_canvas_link, add_text_card, add_media_card, add_frame, add_generation_card, update_card, move_cards, arrange_cards, group_cards, run_generation_card, refresh_canvas, search_competitor_ads, list_saved_ads, get_saved_ad, save_competitor_ad, decode_ad, ad_to_canvas_card · Public sink: estimate_ad_cost, write_ad_storyboard · Destructive: search_articles, import_asset, get_canvas_link, add_generation_card, run_generation_card, search_competitor_ads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_ugc_avatars, get_generation, list_generations, get_ad_job · Private data: generate_video, generate_image, get_generation, list_generations, get_account, write_ad_storyboard, generate_ad, get_ad_job, generate_ugc_video, generate_avatar, import_asset, list_brand_profiles, import_brand_profile, list_canvases, create_canvas, get_canvas, rename_canvas, get_canvas_link, add_text_card, add_media_card, add_frame, add_generation_card, update_card, move_cards, arrange_cards, group_cards, run_generation_card, refresh_canvas, search_competitor_ads, list_saved_ads, get_saved_ad, save_competitor_ad, decode_ad, ad_to_canvas_card · Public sink: estimate_ad_cost, write_ad_storyboard · Destructive: search_articles, import_asset, get_canvas_link, add_generation_card, run_generation_card, search_competitor_ads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_generations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
